target.title: fix(gateway): replace blocking sync I/O with async in auth/credential paths (fixes #78805)
target.body:
## Problem
Gateway auth and credential paths used blocking synchronous I/O (execSync), which blocks the Node.js event loop during authentication operations, slowing gateway responsiveness under load.

## Root Cause
macOS Keychain access and other credential sources were called via `execSync` in auth-profile resolution paths, blocking the event loop.

## Fix
Replaced blocking `execSync` calls with async `execAsync` equivalents in the auth-storage credential paths, allowing the gateway to continue processing other requests during auth operations.

Fixes #78805

## Real Behavior Proof

### Test Results (vitest 4.1.9, Node 22.22.0)

```
 ✓ |agents-core| src/agents/sessions/auth-storage.test.ts (3 tests | 3 passed)
```

All 3 auth-storage tests pass:
- Auth profile storage and retrieval
- Credential persistence across sessions
- Async I/O in credential resolution paths

### Additional verification

Branch rebased onto origin/main (9ac2af50e). No merge conflicts.
